name: job-hunter
description: Let Claude add jobs to your local Job Hunter Board, see which companies and positions you already have, which companies to skip during job searches, read your CV to evaluate job fit, and read your saved job-search instructions.
long_description: Adds five tools. add_job adds a job position to the Board of the Job Hunter account that owns the integration token, optionally with an already-calculated job-fit evaluation that Job Hunter shows as an External AI match. get_companies is read-only and lists the companies already in that account with the titles of their job positions, so Claude can avoid duplicate jobs. get_excluded_companies is read-only and lists the companies you excluded from job discovery in Job Hunter (Settings > Job Search), so Claude skips them during job searches; it never blocks adding a job. get_cv is read-only and returns the CV you uploaded in Job Hunter (always the latest version) as its file name and complete extracted text, which Claude uses to evaluate job fit; the original PDF is also offered, unmodified, as the MCP resource jobhunter://cv/current.pdf. get_search_prompt is read-only and returns the job-search instructions you saved in Job Hunter (Settings > Job Search > Search Prompt), exactly as written and always the latest version; it only retrieves them, and Claude follows them with the other tools when you ask it to run your saved search. Talks only to your own Job Hunter backend.

tools.name: add_job
tools.description: Add one job position to your Job Hunter Board (duplicates are detected by Job Hunter). Optionally include an already-calculated job-fit evaluation (fitScore, matchingSkills, missingSkills, concerns, evaluationModel).

tools.name: get_companies
tools.description: Read-only: list the companies and positions already on your Job Hunter board (any status), used to avoid duplicate jobs.

tools.name: get_excluded_companies
tools.description: Read-only: list the companies you excluded from job discovery in Job Hunter, so Claude skips them during job searches (adding jobs there is still possible).

tools.name: get_cv
tools.description: Read-only: retrieve the CV you uploaded in Job Hunter (latest version) as its file name and complete extracted text, to evaluate job fit. The original PDF is available as the MCP resource jobhunter://cv/current.pdf.

tools.name: get_search_prompt
tools.description: Read-only: retrieve your saved Job Hunter search instructions (Settings > Job Search > Search Prompt) exactly as written, for use in job discovery. It only retrieves them; it never searches or adds jobs by itself.

base_url.title: Job Hunter backend URL
base_url.description: Where your Job Hunter backend runs. Locally this is http://localhost:8080.

token.title: Job Hunter integration token
token.description: Generate it in Job Hunter: Settings > Claude / MCP > Generate token. It is stored in your macOS Keychain.
